comments.text:
Freeing birds feels kind… but sometimes it can put them in danger.
I made this mistake once. My budgie never flew away, she always stayed close. One day, I took her outside to let her fly… and suddenly a crow attacked her. We somehow saved her, but that moment was terrifying and heartbreaking.
Not every pet bird knows how to survive outside. What feels like freedom to us can be risky for them.
Please be careful… love them, but keep them safe too 🤍
